from datetime import date

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    year, month, day_of_month = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Calculate target month and year
    total_months = year * 12 + month + n
    target_year = (total_months - 1) // 12
    target_month = ((total_months - 1) % 12) + 1
    
    # Determine the last day of the target month
    if target_month == 12:
        next_month_first = date(target_year + 1, 1, 1)
    else:
        next_month_first = date(target_year, target_month + 1, 1)
    
    from datetime import timedelta
    last_day_of_target_month = (next_month_first - timedelta(days=1)).day
    
    # Check if original day was the last day of its month
    if month == 12:
        next_month_first_original = date(year + 1, 1, 1)
    else:
        next_month_first_original = date(year, month + 1, 1)
    
    from datetime import timedelta
    last_day_of_original_month = (next_month_first_original - timedelta(days=1)).day
    
    is_last_day = (day_of_month == last_day_of_original_month)
    
    # Apply billing rule
    if is_last_day:
        target_day = last_day_of_target_month
    else:
        target_day = min(day_of_month, last_day_of_target_month)
    
    return f"{target_year:04d}-{target_month:02d}-{target_day:02d}"
